metric_definition.session_recall@k: macro fraction of annotated evidence sessions in the first k returned rounds
metric_definition.turn_recall@k: macro fraction of annotated evidence turns in the first k returned original turns
metric_definition.round_turn_recall@k: macro fraction of annotated evidence turns in the first k returned rounds
metric_definition.unscored: empty gold sets and abstention questions excluded separately per metric
metric_definition.native_rounds: rank anchors by fused score; include only returned original turns and their required premises

limitations: Dev tuning only; retrieval coverage does not establish reader accuracy.
Native lexical measurements do not estimate native Qwen model-stage recall.
Assistant reference retrieval uses lexical scores; existing cached dense keys index user turns.

identity.backend: native lexical BM25; no local model stages

limit_proof.scope: Native lexical path, k=32/role, candidateLimit=128, 64 sources, 65536 bytes, maxRounds=10; every finite assistantWeight in [0,4] and every aggregation-only MMR strength in [0,1].
limit_proof.method: Exact IEEE754 ordering intervals for each non-aggregation question, allowing a separate oracle weight per question. Aggregation questions receive perfect recall as an optimistic bound. Replayed order and closure budgets must match actual native receipts.
limitations: This bounds the measured lexical role-rank fusion class, not retrieval with different relevance scores, model stages, candidate limits, premise policies, or additional query variants.

global_weight_sweep.method: 0.90..1.30 at 0.01 steps, ten rounds, MMR off; reject any per-type session regression, then maximize macro recall and prefer the weight closest to 1 on ties.

provenance.first_attempt: Manifest parsing stopped during incomplete source transfer; no compilation started.
provenance.measurement_note: Final defaults were tested through explicit identical options on this snapshot. Subsequent Rust edits change defaults and validate CLI weights before loading models.

default_rationale: Ten native rounds improve session recall@10 without per-type session regression; five rounds regress and twenty adds context without improving recall@10.

Native assistant weight 0.96 was chosen on dev in a 0.90..1.30 sweep at 0.01 steps with no per-type session regression; the selected configuration was confirmed through the native API. Assistant sources were already indexed in the native baseline.
Reference assistant weight 0.5 improves multi-session coverage without changing any per-type turn recall@10 or round-turn recall@10.
Session MMR stays opt-in: it improves session coverage but lowers evidence-turn coverage on dev.
Subqueries stay off: fusion and cached expansion regress a question type; expansion candidates lack complete main-query reranker coverage.
Native selected first-ten-turn recall decreases for knowledge-update, assistant and preference questions; evidence-turn recall within the full ten returned rounds has no per-type regression.

reproduction.native: uv run --script benchmarks/public/longmemeval_retrieval.py --dev-export DEV.json --native-binary target/release/conversation-eval --native-work NATIVE_WORK --output NATIVE.json
reproduction.limit_and_weight_sweep: uv run --script benchmarks/public/longmemeval_retrieval_limits.py --dev-export DEV.json --native-report NATIVE.json --native-work NATIVE_WORK --output LIMIT.json
reproduction.scope: Frozen 100-question dev split, 94 answerable questions; no held-out record decoded and no reader/judge calls.
